directive.quote: Port from it 1:1 (byte copy, then adapt, recorded in the Workshop ports/ledger). Never rebuild what worked.
directive.attribution: Instruction in a user-supplied handoff that the user explicitly directed the agent to follow; not independently authored by the user.

preserve: Keep hostOf, hostWithin, sameOrigin, pathWithin and urlWithin as the shared browser-pure address rules.
Compare origins exactly and hosts and paths on complete label or segment boundaries.
Use URL parser normalization for case, trailing DNS dots and IDNA; reject addresses carrying credentials.

Keep the selected visitor cookie rule: share the primary address parent only when the caller is inside its complete host-label boundary. Verify the earlier held range independently; its surrounding file is not a full original copy.
allowed_deltas: Move sharedCookieDomain from the selected visitor-offers source, adding maintained public and private suffix data to refuse public suffixes, IPs and malformed primaries.
Canonicalize bare and bracketed IPv6 through the same URL parser.
Reject credentialed URL values consistently in the shared host boundary rule.
banned_substitutions: A text prefix or unbounded suffix host check
An application-specific host or cookie-domain table
A second copy of the shared address rules or an import of a server runtime
